payload.entityId: uuid — the PC or NPC the proposal fills, when the command's target does not name it
payload.prompt: string — the initial prompt, typed; kept as the sheet's initial prompt
payload.audio: string — base64 of the dictated prompt, read only when no prompt is typed: transcribed locally through the speech-to-text port, the transcript taken as the prompt; the audio is neither sent nor stored. With neither, the sheet's own initial prompt is used
